steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the draft.
Apply the configured vendor-addition behavior for the case.
Apply the requested stage configuration before creating the draft.
Configure the draft with an RFQ stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet and controls are enabled.
Add the minimum line item required for a usable draft pricing sheet.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Save the configured eRFX event as a draft.
Open the control under test on the saved draft.
Assert that the opened Price Components menu offers Bulk Discount.
